mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month indicates an active monetary tightening cycle that increases the cost of capital for equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen over the past month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.3%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicates a stagflationary environment that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has risen over the past month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 240.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1050 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 104.0, it indicates a housing boom coupled with manufacturing weakness that signals economic imbalance, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery phase, a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 145,000 thousand indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during the post-pandemic recovery when PAYEMS < 145000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
